#
# AVM CTC Framework - OPTIONAL perceptual metric dependencies.
#
# Unlike requirements.txt this file is NOT generated by pip-compile and is NOT
# hash-pinned: torch publishes platform-specific wheels, so a hashed lock is
# not portable between the macOS development machines and the Linux cluster.
# Versions are pinned where it matters and left open for torch so each
# platform can resolve an appropriate build.
#
# Install:
#   pip install -r requirements-perceptual.txt
# or:
#   ./setup_env.sh --perceptual
#
# For CUDA nodes, install torch from the PyTorch index FIRST, then this file:
#   pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
#   pip install -r requirements-perceptual.txt
#
# LICENCE: pyiqa is PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 + NTU S-Lab (non-commercial
# use only). See requirements-perceptual.in for the rationale and the
# Apache-2.0 alternative.
#

torchvision>=0.15
pyiqa==0.1.16
